text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I told you it's no big deal. I just twisted
it a little
when I stepped down.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You didn't need to take me to the
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I already feel fine. Are you listening? I
need to
keep training.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't have time to lie around. I need to
be on
my feet and running. I...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't have time to lie around. I need to
be on
my feet and running. I...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Fine... I got it. I'll get some rest then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although somewhat reluctant, Admire
Vega
listens to my advice.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's only a light injury. I can still move—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I escort the dejected Admire Vega back
to the
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. It wasn't a serious injury in the
first place.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to keep looking at it.
You're
messing up my concentration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega returns to training while
being
careful not to worsen her injury.
